collector_id.description: Specific route collector identifier. Examples: 'route-views.linx' (RouteViews LINX), 'rrc01' (Amsterdam).

data_type.description: Type of BGP data to retrieve. 'rib' = Routing Information Base (periodic full routing table snapshots, typically every 2-8 hours, ideal for network topology analysis). 'updates' = real-time BGP routing updates (announcements/withdrawals, ideal for studying routing dynamics and outages).

page.description: Page number for paginated results (starts from 1). Use for navigating large datasets when searching broad time periods or popular collectors.

page_size.description: Results per page. Range: 1-1000, default: 100. Use larger values (500-1000) for bulk data discovery, smaller values (10-50) for quick exploration.

project.description: BGP data collection project. Options: 'routeviews' (University of Oregon RouteViews project) or 'riperis' (RIPE NCC Routing Information Service). Each has different collector locations and methodologies.

ts_end.description: End timestamp for data collection period. Same format as ts_start. Combine with ts_start to define a specific time window for targeted BGP event analysis or research.

ts_start.description: Start timestamp for data collection period. Accepts ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-08-01T00:00:00Z') or Unix timestamp. Use to find data from a specific date onwards for historical analysis.
